empty.title: Drop images here
empty.text: Single photos or whole folders. Pixforge enlarges them with AI, on this computer, without uploading.
empty.formats: JPEG · PNG · TIFF · WebP · HEIC (phone) · RAW (camera)

preview.facesHint: Click a frame to exclude that face
preview.refiningHint: Until then the preview shows an approximation, or the original when zoomed out.

panel.title: Settings
panel.modelNotNeeded: Denoising only needs no upscaling model.
panel.etaCpu: About {{t}} on the processor (no suitable graphics card)
panel.note1x: 1× means AI sharpening: Pixforge computes 4× internally and scales back down. It takes as long as 4×. To only remove noise, “Denoise only” takes seconds.
panel.noteDenoise: Same size, noise reduction only: takes seconds and invents no detail.
panel.fineToggleHint: Switch the finishing on and off to compare. The values are kept; when off it is not exported either.
panel.graphicsOnPhoto: These models are trained on clean, downscaled images such as graphics and renderings. On camera and phone photos they turn noise, sharpening and JPEG traces into mosaic patterns. For photos choose “Photos” or “Photos, sharper”.

status.noGpu: No suitable graphics card, using the processor

crop.label: Crop {{w}} × {{h}} px → {{ow}} × {{oh}} px
crop.card: Only the {{w}} × {{h}} px crop is processed and saved as a new image (…_crop).

models.setupText: The AI models for this device are downloaded once ({{size}}). After that Pixforge works offline.

about.text: Upscales and denoises photos with AI, entirely on this computer.
about.ready: Version {{version}} is ready and will be installed when you quit.
about.privacyText: Images never leave this computer. No telemetry; internet only for model downloads and updates.
